massOperation:codeSnippet.adtcore:content: @EndUserText.label: 'Demo-Codes Singleton' @AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED define root view entity ZR_X_DMOARC1STP as select from I_Language left outer join ZTX_DMO_DCODE on 0 = 0 association [0..*] to I_ABAPTransportRequestText as _ABAPTransportRequestText on $projection.TransportRequestID = _ABAPTransportRequestText.TransportRequestID composition [0..*] of ZR_X_DMOArc1TP as _DmoPatternDemoCodes { key 1 as SingletonID, _DmoPatternDemoCodes, max( ZTX_DMO_DCODE.LAST_CHANGED_AT ) as LastChangedAtMax, cast( '' as SXCO_TRANSPORT) as TransportRequestID, _ABAPTransportRequestText } where I_Language.Language = $session.system_language
